name: Stadium Event Security
description: A stadium with an outer concourse and two screening gates. Three drones hold the perimeter, inspect the gates and keep a two-station relay for the crowd-control lead.
creator: Xie Qidong
task_description: A stadium with an outer concourse and two screening gates. Three drones hold the perimeter, inspect the gates and keep a two-station relay for the crowd-control lead.

tasks.content: Command Guard Three to take off to 24.2 meters and hold that altitude, hovering in place while the sensor pod stabilises. The drone reaches its cruise height in the take-off itself; there is no second climb.

tasks.name: Perimeter Patrol With Return 2
tasks.content: Send Guard Two on a perimeter patrol at 26.6 meters: start at corner A (171, 138.8), continue to corner B (855.4, 163.7), corner C (859.3, 606.4) and corner D (212.6, 624.8), then return home and land. The patrol is only complete when the drone is back on the ground at its home position. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.

tasks.name: Relay Link Message Handoff 5
tasks.content: Set up a two-station relay: Guard Two climbs to 25.8 meters and holds over (250, 400), Guard One climbs to 25.8 meters and holds over (564.5, 435.5). Guard Two then sends the message "visual on the target" to Guard One. The two stations are 350 meters apart and must stay within 380 meters of each other. Position beacon: (564.5, 435.5) at 25.8 m. Fly there with a single move_to command rather than a sequence of short hops.

Guard Two and Guard One hover at 25.8 m and pass the report "visual on the target" along the 350 m link.

Report when the drone is back in the air. Position beacon: (150.0, 650.0) at 34.1 m. Fly there with a single move_to command rather than a sequence of short hops.
